title: Do inconsistent docs hurt AI coding agents?
summary:
Somewhere in your docs, two pages disagree. Coding agents often notice, follow the wrong page anyway, and pay for it in extra tokens or a broken build.

The post Do inconsistent docs hurt AI coding agents? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.

title: Is “sort by impact” just vibes?
summary:
You ask an agent for your top five, sorted by impact, and it hands you a confident list. But you never said what impact means, so what did the agent actually sort by? We ran four models through the same lists 1,500 times to find out, and what we found should change how you ask for a ranking.

The post Is “sort by impact” just vibes? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.

title: Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs?
summary:
Should your next API be REST, or something else? And which one will AI coding agents handle best? We tested REST, POST-only and RPC-style APIs with six models across 1,356 runs, and what decided whether agents succeeded had nothing to do with API style.

The post Do AI coding agents struggle with non-REST APIs? appeared first on Microsoft for Developers.
